scope: All 44 standalone ordinary ORM index-name mismatches, excluding three constraint-owned names and five external-only duplicates. Definitions and ordered plain columns are identical; align model names to existing external/embedded names and use guarded ALTER INDEX RENAME to retain OIDs, storage and dependencies. Raw generator DROP/CREATE output is inspection-only, not the deployed upgrade. No production execution.
